card.name: Suicidality and mood-change warning wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, of, not) inside the antidepressant-style warning about worsening depression, unusual behavior changes and suicidal thoughts. Also weaker on partial words in 'paradoxical' bronchospasm and 'abnormal thinking'.
